step2_adaptive_thresholding.finding: POT's non-monotonic tail transform collapses the score bulk to a constant, destroying ranking quality (VUS-ROC -0.055). The apparent VUS-PR gain (+0.013) is a bulk-flattening artifact, not real calibration improvement. At standard SPOT q=1e-3, POT is catastrophic (recall 0.003). At its best operating point it merely matches a naive 99th-percentile threshold. POT sweep over q in {1e-3, 5e-3, 1e-2, 5e-2, 1e-1} x init_quantile in {0.90, 0.95, 0.99} confirmed VUS-ROC degrades monotonically. See step2b_pot_sweep.json.

step3_hyperparameter_tuning.method: Coordinate descent: Round A (HEDGE_ETA x d_target) then Round B (CUSUM_KC x CUSUM_HC_SIGMA_MULT), on 9-series search subset, validated on full 18-series subset
step3_hyperparameter_tuning.main_driver: d_target=16 (doubling embedding dimension from default 8) accounts for most of the gain; HEDGE_ETA=0.05 (halving learning rate) contributes modestly; CUSUM parameters have minimal effect
step3_hyperparameter_tuning.caveat: Validation subset (18) includes the search subset (9), so validation is not fully held-out. Improvement needs confirmation on the full 350-series eval split.

decision_gate.rationale: Tuning alone showed meaningful improvement: VUS-PR +24% (0.2165 -> 0.2682), now beating the persistence baseline (0.2682 vs 0.2144). VUS-ROC also improved (+4.6%). Thresholding was negative and does not contribute. Gate passes on tuning merit alone.
decision_gate.next_action: Proceed to Step 5: full TSB-AD-U tuning split run

combined_result.thresholding_alone: NEGATIVE (VUS-ROC regression, no real precision gain)
combined_result.combined: Not computed — thresholding was negative so no combination applied. Tuning alone is the improvement vector.
